description: Defines the FileSystemMonitor class with platform-specific implementations for file system change notifications, including nested classes for callbacks, observers, and a dispatcher thread. It manages registration, unregistration, and notification of file system events on Linux, macOS, and Windows.

classes.name: FileSystemMonitor
classes.description: Monitors file system changes with platform-specific implementations, allowing registration and notification of callbacks for directory or file changes.

classes.name: FileSystemMonitor::ICallback
classes.description: Interface for callback objects to be notified of file system updates.

classes.name: FileSystemMonitor::Observer
classes.description: Manages a list of callbacks for a specific file or directory, handles registration, unregistration, and notification.

classes.name: FileSystemMonitor::Context
classes.description: Platform-specific class for managing directory change notifications, including handling overlapped I/O and callback invocation.

classes.name: FileSystemMonitor::Dispatcher
classes.description: A thread class that processes file system events and manages synchronization.

methods.name: FileSystemMonitor::Instance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of the FileSystemMonitor.

methods.name: FileSystemMonitor::Register
methods.description: Registers a callback for a specified file or directory to receive change notifications.

methods.name: FileSystemMonitor::Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a callback from a specified file or directory.

methods.name: FileSystemMonitor::IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the monitor is properly initialized and valid.
